note: Offline relevance eval for the search reranker. Docs are short semantic facts; each query gives natural-language phrasing plus the ids of the genuinely relevant docs. The set is seeded to include lexical traps — distractors that share query keywords without answering, and relevant docs that use synonyms — so RRF alone is imperfect and a cross-encoder has room to help. Extend it; it is a seed, not a benchmark.

docs.title: Access token lifetime
docs.content: Access tokens are valid for 15 minutes; after that the client must mint a new one with its refresh token.

docs.title: Refresh token rotation
docs.content: Refresh tokens rotate on every use and are revoked after 30 days of inactivity, forcing a full re-login.

docs.title: Login page redesign
docs.content: The login screen was redesigned with a new logo and a single email-first field; no change to auth behaviour.

docs.title: Password reset flow
docs.content: A reset email carries a one-time link valid for one hour; clicking it invalidates all existing sessions.

docs.title: Billing invoice generation
docs.content: Invoices are generated nightly at 02:00 UTC and emailed to the account owner the next morning.

docs.title: Payment retry policy
docs.content: A failed card charge is retried after 1, 3 and 5 days; the third failure downgrades the account to the free tier.

docs.title: Refund handling
docs.content: Refunds are issued to the original payment method and can take five to ten business days to appear.

docs.title: Billing pipeline deploy
docs.content: The billing service deploys nightly through the release runbook with a Slack notification to #payments.

docs.title: Kafka ingestion topics
docs.content: The ingestion service consumes events from the orders and clicks Kafka topics and writes them to the warehouse.

docs.title: Consumer lag alerting
docs.content: An alert fires when a consumer group falls more than 10k messages behind; the on-call is paged after five minutes.

docs.title: Dead letter queue
docs.content: Messages that fail processing three times are parked on a dead-letter queue for manual replay the next day.

docs.title: Warehouse nightly load
docs.content: The analytics warehouse is loaded from the raw event tables every night; late-arriving events are backfilled hourly.

docs.title: Deploy freeze windows
docs.content: Deploys are frozen from Friday 18:00 to Monday 09:00 and during the last three days of the quarter.

docs.title: Rollback procedure
docs.content: To undo a bad release, redeploy the previous image tag; database migrations must be reverted by a separate down-migration.

docs.title: CI test suite
docs.content: The pipeline runs unit and integration tests on every push; a green run is required before the merge button unlocks.

docs.title: Feature flag rollout
docs.content: New features ship dark behind a flag and are ramped 1%, 10%, 50%, 100% while error rates are watched.

docs.title: SQLite WAL mode
docs.content: The database runs in write-ahead-logging mode so readers never block the single writer; checkpoints fold the WAL back.

docs.title: Busy timeout tuning
docs.content: A 15-second busy timeout plus immediate transactions lets concurrent processes wait out a held write lock instead of erroring.

docs.title: Vacuum schedule
docs.content: The database is compacted weekly during the maintenance window to reclaim pages left by deleted rows.

docs.title: Redis cache eviction
docs.content: The cache uses an LRU policy with a 512MB ceiling; hot keys are pinned with a longer TTL to survive eviction.

docs.title: Cache stampede guard
docs.content: On a cache miss a single request holds a lock and recomputes while others wait, so a cold key can't overwhelm the origin.

docs.title: Rate limiting
docs.content: Public endpoints allow 100 requests per minute per IP; exceeding it returns 429 with a Retry-After header.

docs.title: On-call rotation
docs.content: The on-call engineer changes every Monday; handover notes are posted in the incident channel before the shift ends.

docs.title: Incident severity levels
docs.content: SEV1 is a full outage paged immediately; SEV3 is a minor degradation handled during business hours.

docs.title: Postmortem template
docs.content: Every SEV1 gets a blameless writeup within three days covering timeline, root cause and follow-up actions.

docs.title: Embedding model
docs.content: Text is embedded with multilingual-e5-small into 384-dim vectors; query and passage use different prompt prefixes.

docs.title: Vector search recall
docs.content: Nearest-neighbour lookup returns the closest chunks by cosine distance; results feed the fusion stage before ranking.

docs.title: Hybrid ranking
docs.content: Full-text and vector candidates are merged with reciprocal rank fusion, then time-decay and graph signals reorder them.

docs.title: Memory decay
docs.content: Episodic records lose relevance with age on a two-week half-life, while durable facts keep a steady rank.

docs.title: Graph expansion
docs.content: After fusion the top hits pull in one-hop neighbours over typed edges so related context surfaces without a keyword match.
